adv_leaf_rust.en: Looks like coffee leaf rust. Pick off badly hit leaves and bury them, prune and weed for air, add manure. Ask your agent about a copper spray.
adv_leaf_rust.lg: Kirabika kukwata kwa kutalagga ku bikoola (leaf rust). Noga ebikoola ebyonoonese obiziike, sala amatabi, koola, teekamu nakavundira. Buuza omulimisa.

adv_phoma.en: Looks like Phoma (cold-weather blight). Cut off black, dying tips and burn them, shelter young trees from cold wind, avoid wounds. Ask your agent.
adv_phoma.lg: Kirabika Phoma (obulwadde bw'empewo). Salako ensonda enzirugavu ezikala ozyokye, kuuma emiti emito okuva ku mpewo, togisala bubi. Buuza omulimisa.

adv_healthy.en: Your coffee sounds healthy. Keep weeding, mulching and pruning. Check under the leaves each week and text us if you see spots or powder.
adv_healthy.lg: Emmwanyi zo zirabika nnamu. Weeyongere okukoola, okubikka n'okusala amatabi. Kebera wansi w'ebikoola buli wiiki, otuwandiikire bw'olaba amabala.

clarify.en: To be sure: are the marks on the leaves or on the berries, and what colour are they?
clarify.lg: Okukakasa: obubonero buli ku bikoola oba ku bibala, era bya langi ki?

clarify_where.en: Where do you see the problem: on the leaves, the berries, the stems or the roots?
clarify_where.lg: Ekizibu okirabira wa: ku bikoola, ku bibala, ku bikolo oba ku mirandira?

clarify_colour.en: What do you see on the leaves: orange powder underneath, black or brown patches, or no marks?
clarify_colour.lg: Kiki ky'olaba ku bikoola: obuwunga bwa kacungwa wansi, amabala amaddugavu oba ag'ekitaka, oba tewali kabonero?

clarify_rust_phoma.en: Is it orange powder under the leaves, or are the tips of young leaves turning black and dry?
clarify_rust_phoma.lg: Buwunga bwa kacungwa wansi w'ebikoola, oba ensonda z'ebikoola ebito zifuuka nzirugavu ne zikala?

unsure.en: I am not sure what this is. A field agent has been alerted and will call you.
unsure.lg: Sikakasa kino kye ki. Omulimisa amanyisiddwa era ajja kukukubira essimu.

welcome.en: Coffee Advisor: free coffee advice by SMS. We keep your messages to advise you. Describe your leaves, or send PRICE, HELP, or STOP to end.
welcome.lg: Coffee Advisor: amagezi ku mmwanyi ku SMS, bwereere. Tukuuma obubaka bwo. Nnyonnyola ebikoola, oba weereza PRICE, HELP, oba STOP okukomya.

help.en: Send PRICE for coffee prices, AGENT to reach a person, or describe your coffee leaves. STOP to end.
help.lg: Weereza PRICE ku bbeeyi y'emmwanyi, AGENT okwogera n'omuntu, oba nnyonnyola ebikoola by'emmwanyi zo. STOP okukomya.

prices.en: Coffee prices, UCDA {date}, UGX per kg: {body}. Do not sell for less.
prices.lg: Bbeeyi y'emmwanyi, UCDA {date}, UGX buli kilo: {body}. Totunda wansi w'eno.

prices_unavailable.en: Prices are not available right now. Please try again later.
prices_unavailable.lg: Bbeeyi teriiwo kati. Ddamu ogezeeko oluvannyuma.

stop_ack.en: You will get no more messages. Send START to come back.
stop_ack.lg: Tojja kuddamu kufuna bubaka. Weereza START okudda.

start_ack.en: Welcome back. Describe your coffee leaves, or send PRICE.
start_ack.lg: Tukwaniriza nate. Nnyonnyola ebikoola by'emmwanyi zo, oba weereza PRICE.

followup_q.en: How are your coffee plants 3 days on? Reply 1 better, 2 same, 3 worse.
followup_q.lg: Emmwanyi zo ziri zitya oluvannyuma lw'ennaku 3? Ddamu 1 zirongooka, 2 bwe zityo, 3 zeeyongedde okwonooneka.

followup_ok.en: Good. Keep following the advice. Text us any time.
followup_ok.lg: Kirungi. Weeyongere okugoberera amagezi. Tuwandiikire ekiseera kyonna.

followup_worse.en: Sorry to hear that. A field agent has been alerted and will call you.
followup_worse.lg: Kitunakuwazizza. Omulimisa amanyisiddwa era ajja kukukubira essimu.

agent_requested.en: An agent has been alerted and will call you soon.
agent_requested.lg: Omulimisa amanyisiddwa era ajja kukukubira mangu.
